Airtel Africa plc
(‘Airtel Africa’, or the ‘Company’)
Transaction in Own Shares
London and Lagos, 29 September 2026: Airtel Africa announces that in the
period 21 September 2026 to 28 September 2026 it purchased the following
number of its ordinary shares of USD 0.50 each from Barclays Capital
Securities Limited (“Barclays”) pursuant to the authority granted by its
shareholders as part of its share buyback programme, details of which were
announced on 22 May 2026.

Since the commencement of the buyback programme on 22 May 2026, the
Company has purchased 24,515,062 ordinary shares in aggregate, at a volume
weighted average price of 331.29 GBp per ordinary share. These purchases
represent the last purchases under the initial tranche of the buyback
programme initially announced on 22 May 2026. This tranche has now been
completed in accordance with its terms

Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the buyback programme.
